# sensor-run-packing

Behavior contract:
pack(values) consumes a finite iterable and returns a list of (value, count) tuples for maximal adjacent equal runs. Equality is Python ==; values may include None, zero, empty strings and lists. Empty input returns []. Consume a one-shot iterable once and preserve original order.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
